mapper.insert: INSERT INTO desktop_auth_handoffs (code_hash, user_id, display_name, email, avatar_url, code_challenge, expires_at) VALUES (#{codeHash}, #{userId}, #{displayName}, #{email}, #{avatarUrl}, #{codeChallenge}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.select: WITH consumed AS ( DELETE FROM desktop_auth_handoffs WHERE code_hash = #{codeHash} RETURNING code_hash, user_id, display_name, email, avatar_url, code_challenge, expires_at ) SELECT code_hash, user_id, display_name, email, avatar_url, code_challenge, expires_at FROM consumed WHERE expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM desktop_auth_handoffs WHERE expires_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
